LanguageData.RS_EnhancedAssaultDescription: Raiders carry and recover limited ladder kits. Eligible concentrated raids may deploy a fortified artillery camp, while sappers favor demolition troops. Existing entrances and shared routes remain in use.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Ordinary: This raiding party has artillery support. They will first establish a gun position before the infantry attacks to support the raid.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Breaching: This breaching force has artillery support. They will first establish a gun position before the infantry attacks to support the raid.
LanguageData.RS_ArtilleryRaidArrival_Siege: This siege force has reinforced artillery. They will establish a fortified gun position and sustain a bombardment of your defenders and fortifications in preparation for a breakthrough.
